ABOUT IREN

What is IREN?

IREN Investors Limited is presented as a platform for exploring mining and technology hardware project opportunities in one place. It brings project information, wallet activity and portfolio tracking together in a clear and simple experience.

Use the Projects button to view all available projects, arranged under A IREN, B IREN and C IREN. A IREN contains four projects, B IREN contains six projects, and C IREN is currently empty.
